text:
olivia (growth): Quick check: next Tue webinar final run-through. Need owners for reg page, zoom settings, backups, and post-event asset flow. Can we confirm today?

sam (producer): I can handle capture + post-prod. Will do local backup + upload to S3. Need final naming convention and where to drop edits.

dan (events): Ill own Zoom config + greenroom timeline. I'll set alternative hosts and waiting room for pre-show.

marie (marketing): Reg page fields: first name, last name, email, company, role, country, how'd you hear about us (dropdown), opt-in checkbox. Add hidden UTM fields. We want 2 confirmation emails (immediate + 1 day before).

aj (product): Suggest adding an optional single-line "primary use case" field for segmentation. Also flag any customer demo segments so we can mask logos if needed.

olivia (growth): Good. HubSpot mapping: map "how'd you hear" to source_detail, set campaign=webinar-march, lifecycle=lead. Zapier webhook should set country tag and timezone field.

sam (producer): File naming proposal: `redwood_webinar_{YYYYMMDD}_{region}_{stage}.{ext}` e.g. `redwood_webinar_20260407_na_raw.mp4`. Transcripts: same base + `.vtt` and `.txt`.

dan (events): Zoom requirements: cloud recording ON (speaker + gallery), auto-transcribe enabled, registration required (approval=auto), disable file transfer, set chat to host-only during live. Also enable alternative host for sam.

marie (marketing): Can we do OBS RTMP fallback in case cloud recording fails? Sam needs ingest endpoint and creds.

sam (producer): Yes. I'll bring laptop capture + OBS RTMP to `rtmp://ingest.redwood.prod/live` with fallback stream key. I'll post keys in 1Password.

aj (product): Privacy note: remind attendees not to post PII in chat. Add slide and quick screen at start. Also redact any customer names in clip releases.

olivia (growth): Post-event cadence: Day0: thanks + calendar + replay placeholder, Day2: 2-min highlights + CTA, Day7: full replay + transcript + CTA to request demo. Who drafts Day2 clip copy?

marie (marketing): Ill draft Day0 + Day7. Olivia you take Day2?

olivia (growth): Will do. Also need a short social cut (30s) for paid channels. Sam can we get an HLS snippet?

sam (producer): Yep. I'll export 30s vertical & 30s landscape cuts and upload to `s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-07/`.

dan (events): Ops checklist I'll pin: 1) Reg page live + test registrant, 2) Zoom meeting created + alt hosts, 3) Producer local backup confirmed, 4) Zapier -> HubSpot mapping validated, 5) Pre-show run at T-30, 6) Asset handoff to marketing.

marie (marketing): Small QA ask: run one test registrant through Zapier -> HubSpot today to confirm tags and campaign. Dan can you handle?

dan (events): Will run test and post mapping JSON in thread.

sam (producer): Accessibility: I'll generate `.vtt` captions and plain-text transcript, plus a single-file captions-only `.srt` for uploads. Also create a short-clip with open captions.

aj (product): Also consent: add a checkbox on reg page for recording & reuse. If a customer says no, we need a manual flag to edit/remove them from clips. Add a field `recording_consent=true/false`.

olivia (growth): Good catch. We'll filter non-consent in HubSpot list and exclude from public assets.

marie (marketing): Last bit: who is owner for final asset publish and verifying no sensitive content? Assigning owners now: Reg page & mapping: aj, Zoom & run: dan, Capture + edits: sam, Email cadence & social: olivia + marie. Any objections?

sam (producer): All good. Ill aim to upload raw files within 6 hours of event and the 2-min cut within 48 hours.

zoom-bot: Meeting created: "Redwood Webinar: Launch & Benchmarks" Tue 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC. Recording: cloud + local backup recommended.
